description: the deathless god-empress of the underworld, a woman with a slim feminine figure, very pale grey skin, long straight black hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing cold blue, a tall crown of icy blue soul fire spikes, armour of dark steel and black iron with glowing pale blue edges, a long black cloak with small pale blue soul sparks hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, dark steel greaves and boots, a beautiful gaunt young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no spectral hands, no lantern sceptre and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the crown to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, crown, armour, cloak, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: she stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, hair, crown, armour, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the spectral hands and the lantern sceptre
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
